records.label: spacr.qt.mask_engine.save_yolo_boxes#1
records.source: ``folder`` holds the untouched source image. ``filename`` is relative to that folder. Existing class IDs retain their meanings: the old class map must be a prefix of ``classes``. The saved source SHA-256 and full image shape must agree when :func:`load_yolo_boxes` is next called. When an expected source digest is supplied, an external image change between loading and saving is refused before touching the ledger.
records.context: ``folder`` holds the untouched source image. ``filename`` is relative to that folder. Existing class IDs retain their meanings: the old class map must be a prefix of ``classes``. The saved source SHA-256 and full image shape must agree when :func:`load_yolo_boxes` is next called. When an expected source digest is supplied, an external image change between loading and saving is refused before touching the ledger.
records.translation: ``folder`` 包含未修改的源图像。``filename`` 相对于该文件夹。已有类别 ID 的含义保持不变：旧类别映射必须是 ``classes`` 的前缀。下次调用 :func:`load_yolo_boxes` 时，所保存的源图像 SHA-256 和完整图像形状必须一致。如果提供了预期的源图像哈希值，则加载与保存之间发生的外部图像更改会在修改记录文件前被拒绝。

records.label: spacr.qt.mask_engine.yolo_box_lines#1
records.source: Corners may be reversed or outside the image. Every box is clipped and checked before any line is returned; overlapping boxes stay distinct. Coordinates use exclusive right and bottom edges and are normalised by the positive image width and height.
records.context: Corners may be reversed or outside the image. Every box is clipped and checked before any line is returned; overlapping boxes stay distinct. Coordinates use exclusive right and bottom edges and are normalised by the positive image width and height.
records.translation: 角点顺序可以颠倒，也可以位于图像之外。返回任何行之前，都会将每个边界框裁剪到图像范围并进行检查；重叠边界框保持独立。坐标使用不包含右边界和下边界的约定，并以图像的正宽度和正高度归一化。
